metadata.title: SOCRadar Alarms for Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.description: Bidirectional integration: Import SOCRadar alarms to Microsoft Sentinel, sync closed incidents back to SOCRadar. Includes optional audit logging, custom alarms table for analytics, and Workbook dashboard.
metadata.author: SOCRadar

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name

Region of the Log Analytics workspace (e.g., centralus, northeurope). This is the region of the WORKSPACE, which can differ from the region of the resource group you deploy into; read it from the workspace Overview blade rather than assuming. A wrong value fails the deployment with LinkedResourceNotFound: Linked Workspace ... was not found in location <region>; if the workspace name is correct, that error means this parameter is wrong.
How often to check for new alarms (1-60 minutes)

Push the Microsoft Sentinel incident severity back to SOCRadar when an incident is closed. On by default. The write only ever raises a severity: Microsoft Sentinel has no Critical, so a SOCRadar CRITICAL alarm is never lowered to High, and an equal or lower Microsoft Sentinel severity is not written. Set to false to never write severity.
How far back to look on first run (default: 600 = 10 hours)
Import all alarm statuses (OPEN, RESOLVED, MITIGATED, FALSE_POSITIVE). Default: only OPEN

Direct: the import Logic App creates one Microsoft Sentinel incident per SOCRadar alarm (current behaviour). AlertBacked: the import writes alarms to the SOCRadar_Alarms_CL table and a scheduled analytics rule raises one alert and one incident per alarm, so the incidents also appear in the Microsoft Defender portal. AlertBacked needs the workspace in this resource group; the alarms table is deployed with it.
Log all operations to Log Analytics for auditing
Store alarms in custom Log Analytics table (SOCRadar_Alarms_CL) for analytics and KQL queries
Data retention in days for custom tables (30-730, default: 1 year)
Internal: Logic Apps start 3 min after deploy for role propagation
Resource group of the existing Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Leave default if workspace is in same RG.
Microsoft Sentinel role for the Logic Apps. Responder sufficient for incident ops (least-privilege).

Extract IP, domain and URL indicators from alarm details and attach them to the incident as entities. Requires Microsoft Sentinel Contributor for the import playbook because bookmark write is not included in Responder. When false, the import identity keeps the SentinelRoleLevel role.

Create a new Log Analytics workspace named WorkspaceName. Leave false when the workspace already exists. The workspace resource declares no workspace-level settings, so even a mistaken true cannot rewrite an existing workspace's pricing tier, retention or daily cap: a template only overwrites the fields it states, and this one states none. A new workspace is created with the subscription default tier. Only honoured when WorkspaceResourceGroup is the deployment resource group, because a workspace cannot be created in another resource group from here.

properties.description: Raises one alert, and one incident, for every SOCRadar alarm the import Logic App writes to SOCRadar_Alarms_CL. Deployed only when IncidentMode is AlertBacked.
properties.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| where ingestion_time() > ago(10m)
| where toupper(Status) == "OPEN"
| where isnotempty(AlarmId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| extend AlarmUrl = strcat("https://platform.socradar.com/company/", CompanyId, "/alarm/", AlarmId)
| extend SentinelSeverity = case(toupper(Severity) in ("CRITICAL", "HIGH"), "High", toupper(Severity) == "MEDIUM", "Medium", "Low")
| extend AlarmDescription = strcat(substring(AlarmText, 0, 1500), "\n\nSOCRadar severity: ", toupper(Severity))
| project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, CompanyId, Title, AlarmText, AlarmDescription, AlarmMainType, AlarmSubType, Severity, Status, AlarmDate, AlarmUrl, SentinelSeverity
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 149
